title: Alert
description: Displays an important message inline, such as system notices or the result of an action.

with-title.title: With title
with-title.description: Add a title above the content. showIcon={false} hides the icon.

closable.title: Closable
closable.description: closable adds a close button; closeIcon replaces its icon and onClose is called on close.

with-action.title: With action
with-action.description: Render buttons or links on the right with action.

collapsible.title: Collapsible
collapsible.description: With a title, collapsible lets users expand and collapse the content.

banner.title: Banner
banner.description: Banner mode for notices at the top of a page.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Custom icon, elevation, outlined, filled and corner radius options.

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: Choose the entrance animation or turn it off.

AlertProps.title: Alert title
AlertProps.variant: Semantic variant, which sets the color and default icon
AlertProps.icon: Custom icon, replacing the variant icon
AlertProps.onClose: Called when the close button is clicked
AlertProps.action: Action area rendered on the right, e.g. buttons
AlertProps.filled: Fills the background with the variant color
AlertProps.banner: Banner mode, suited to page-level notices at the top of a page
AlertProps.collapsible: Lets the content be expanded and collapsed (requires a title)
AlertProps.defaultExpanded: Whether the content is initially expanded
AlertProps.onExpand: Called when the content is expanded or collapsed
